settings.question: How long does a custom piece take to create?
settings.answer: Most custom pieces take 4–6 weeks from design approval to delivery. Complex designs may require additional time.

settings.question: Can I see a 3D render before production?
settings.answer: Yes. We provide detailed 3D visualisations for your approval before any manufacturing begins.

settings.question: What materials can I choose from?
settings.answer: We offer white gold, yellow gold, rose gold, platinum, and silver — all ethically sourced and certified.

settings.question: Do you offer free shipping on custom orders?
settings.answer: Yes, all custom jewellery orders include complimentary insured shipping within the UK.

settings.question: Can you ship internationally?
settings.answer: We ship worldwide. International delivery times and costs vary by destination.

settings.question: Can I return a custom piece?
settings.answer: Because each custom piece is made to your specifications, returns are handled on a case-by-case basis. We work closely with you during the design phase to ensure complete satisfaction.

settings.question: How do I get started?
settings.answer: Simply fill in the custom design request form above, or book a consultation with one of our experts.

settings.question: Is there a minimum budget for custom work?
settings.answer: We welcome projects of all sizes. Our team will work with you to create something beautiful within your budget.
